tldr: No backlog items shipped in this window (2026-08-15 → 2026-09-04, a three-week gap since last audit — routine skipped 2026-08-21 and 2026-08-28 runs). Only intervening commit was PR #121 (referral-form UX fix: report why a submission failed) — a working-form improvement not tied to the audit backlog. Search visibility: 30 queries re-checked against live SERPs on 2026-09-04. **FOURTH-EVER RANKED QUERY + FIRST WIN OUTSIDE THE SPORTS-INJURY-RECOVERY URL — Meridian's /conditions/pregnancy-back-pain/ debuts at #4 on 'pregnancy back pain christchurch'**, in an SERP where triskelionconcussioncare.co.nz holds #1 and osteo.co.nz #2. Industry signals (2026-08-15 → 2026-09-04, three-week window): (1) **August 2026 spam update — hit rankings harder than normal but YMYL was steadiest.** Update launched Aug 18 at 12:30 pm ET, finished Aug 21 at 4:50 am ET (rollout ~2 days 16 hrs, global, all languages). SE Ranking analysis: 16.71% of URLs that had ranked in Google's top 10 fell beyond position 100 for the same keyword during the update vs 9.2% during a comparable 5-day baseline. Case studies (Glenn Gabe / gsqi.com) show it targeted scaled content abuse, AI content, programmatic content, thin affiliates — not something Meridian's pages fit. Healthcare / real estate were reported as the STEADIEST YMYL segments (fashion/beauty had the largest top-10 volatility). Cross-checked against Meridian's live SERPs this run: no unusual competitor churn beyond the SERP volatility already tracked. No action needed. (2) **Google Site Reputation Policy update (Aug 28) — EEA-only carve-out.** Beginning Aug 30, manual actions applied under the site-reputation policy have different effects for searches inside vs outside the EEA. Zero relevance for a Christchurch clinic serving NZ patients. Noted only for completeness. (3) **Reddit-in-ChatGPT citations COLLAPSED — but Perplexity doubled down.** Between Jul 1 and Aug 19, 2026, Perplexity supplied 71% of Reddit citations tracked while ChatGPT supplied 23%. ChatGPT Search citations linking to Reddit fell from ~250/day in early Aug to 16/day in the week after Aug 14 — a -94% decline in six days. This shifts the item-#15 posture: Reddit-seeding for ChatGPT-visibility is now a much weaker lever (though it recovered from a similar drop earlier this year, so may return); Reddit-seeding for Perplexity-visibility is now a STRONGER lever (Reddit's Perplexity share ~24%). Also relevant: the 90% domain-overlap gap between Perplexity and ChatGPT (only ~11% overlap) means Perplexity's citation pool is smaller and more curated — a single well-structured page from a NZ clinic can show up in Perplexity answer cards if it directly answers the query. Item #15 body updated. (4) **AI Mode local pack now often shows 1-2 businesses instead of 3** (Sterling Sky June tracking, still holding per SEL coverage this window). Feeds directly into #13 + #16 — fewer slots means the recency + response-rate signals matter more relative to a broader 3-slot pack. (5) **Whitespark 2026 Local Search Ranking Factors — owner response within 48 hours now tracked as a separate behavioral signal.** 89% of consumers expect businesses to respond to reviews; 81% expect a reply within a week; next-day expectations climbed to 32% (from 18% a year ago). BrightLocal 2026 consumer survey: 50% of consumers are actively put off by generic or templated review responses. Combined: #16 recommendation refined to (a) same-week response as a hard floor, (b) 24-48hr target for freshness weight, (c) response text must be personalised, not templated. (6) **Ahrefs 1,885-page schema study finalised (Aug 2026).** Ahrefs tracked 1,885 pages that added JSON-LD schema between Aug 2025 and Mar 2026, matched against 4,000 controls, measured citation changes across Google AI Overviews / AI Mode / ChatGPT — adding schema produced NO MAJOR UPLIFT in citations on any platform. Reinforces the Feb 2026 Fischman study (730 AI citations, 75 commercial queries): dominant predictor of AI citation is Google organic rank position (position-1 pages cited in 43% of queries), not schema. Item #12 (speakable schema) firmly downweighted — but Meridian's existing schema stack is not the problem to fix; body-copy + rank-position work matters more. (7) **AI SEO stats** — AI Overviews now respond to 68% of local searches (per Semrush AI Overviews study); position-1 organic CTR fell from 1.41% to 0.64% on pages where an AI Overview appears (Ahrefs, -54% effective drop). Traditional-organic-only strategy is losing yield; the AI-citation angle matters even more than at start of year. Tier 1 → #35 (still highest-value first-party AI-visibility signal we can get). Tier 2 → #13, #16, #25, #32, #36. Tier 3 → #14 (elevated leverage given the pregnancy-back-pain ranking win — condition-page URLs demonstrably rank and this validates URL-per-condition thesis for a second page), #15 (rebalanced posture: Perplexity-oriented now, ChatGPT downweighted).

gaps.why: Freshness cliff at ~3 months. Confirmed again 2026-09-04: content depth + freshness remain the dominant differentiator against blog-post-heavy competitors like osteopath-christchurch.com (headaches / migraine / cranial / baby / arthritis), MK Osteopathy (TMJ), headachetendon.nz (chiropractor #1 on 'lower back pain christchurch' — 3+ weeks running as of last check), and now triskelionconcussioncare.co.nz's cross-body-region expansion into arthritis / back-pain / neck-pain / concussion via dedicated landing URLs. Meridian's Practitioner Spotlight infrastructure (PR #108) is the closest thing we have to blog cadence — one entry per month, homepage-surface only, not a separate URL. Item #14 covers the full blog build. **NEW EVIDENCE THIS RUN**: Meridian's /conditions/pregnancy-back-pain/ debuts at #4 on 'pregnancy back pain christchurch' — the second condition-page URL to rank (sports-injury-recovery was the first). This is direct evidence that the URL-per-condition thesis holds and generalises: dedicated, indexable, schema-marked condition URLs with citation-ready intros and structured lists CAN rank in this market. Reinforces the case for item #14 — a blog collection built on the same infrastructure (condition-URL-per-post, MedicalCondition + FAQPage schema, 40-60 word intro per #31, list blocks per #34, author byline with Physician schema, datePublished + dateModified) is the highest-leverage path to more ranked URLs. **AND**: the sports-injury regression this run (both sports-injury queries lost their ranks in a single week) argues that scale matters — ONE ranked URL is fragile to competitor churn, TEN ranked URLs are not.

gaps.title: No off-site citation strategy
gaps.why: Reddit is a major AI-citation source but the platform mix shifted sharply this window. UPDATED 2026-09-04: Between Jul 1 and Aug 19, 2026, Perplexity supplied 71% of tracked Reddit citations while ChatGPT supplied 23%; ChatGPT Search citations linking to Reddit fell from ~250/day in early Aug to 16/day the week after Aug 14 — a -94% decline in six days. Reddit's Perplexity share is now ~24%, Gemini 0.1%. This shifts posture: Reddit-seeding for Perplexity-visibility remains a strong lever (larger share, smaller more curated source pool means single well-structured posts can surface); Reddit-seeding for ChatGPT-visibility is much weaker (though it's recovered from similar drops earlier this year — may return). ClaudeBot overtook GPTBot at 16.28% vs 9.74% (Cloudflare July 2026) — Reddit-in-Claude is a separate open question. **The time-decay clock started 2026-08-14 (Perplexity motion to dismiss the Reddit scraping suit rejected 31 Jul; Reddit/Google $60M/yr licensing renewal talks stalled)** and the ChatGPT collapse this window is one instance of that decay. Item #15 stays on the backlog but its optimal scope has narrowed: focus Reddit effort on Perplexity-cited threads (r/newzealand medical + healthcare threads that Perplexity is likely to pull), skip the ChatGPT-oriented seeding. 90/10 rule still applies: 90% non-promotional, 2–4 weeks of karma-building before any mention of Meridian.

items.title: Add speakable blocks on service intros
items.body: Add schema.org speakable specification on service intro paragraphs for voice assistants / Gemini Live. With the citation-ready 40–60 word answers now in place (item #31 shipped 2026-05-17), wrapping them in a speakable block is the natural follow-up — gives voice assistants a single span to read aloud rather than guessing. DOWNWEIGHTED 2026-08-07: Ahrefs schema-impact study (+2.4% AI Mode / +2.2% ChatGPT / –4.6% AIO across 1,885 pages) held up in late-July commentary; consensus is schema is a context signal, not a lever. Speakable specifically has been in beta 7 years without leaving beta. **REINFORCED 2026-09-04**: Ahrefs' 1,885-page schema study was finalised — pages that added JSON-LD schema between Aug 2025 and Mar 2026 vs 4,000 controls showed NO MAJOR UPLIFT in AI citations across Google AI Overviews / AI Mode / ChatGPT. The Feb 2026 Fischman study (730 AI citations, 75 commercial queries, health included) found the dominant predictor of AI citation is Google organic rank position: position-1 pages cited in 43% of queries. Body copy + rank-position work matter more than any additional schema type. Keep on the list because it's still cheap, but do NOT invest engineering time in schema-type expansion over body-copy / condition-page work.

items.title: Auto-fetch Google Business Profile reviews at build time
items.body: So reviewCount / ratingValue stay current without manual edits. Build script hits Places API with a 24h cache. REINFORCED 2026-08-07: Whitespark's 2026 Local Search Ranking Factors report now names review recency as the #1 individual local ranking factor (reviews <30 days carry full algorithmic weight; 30–180 days decays to 10–20%; 73% of consumers only trust reviews from the last month per Epicware July 2026). Gemini and AI Overviews now use review sentiment + keywords to pick which local businesses to recommend, so review freshness feeds both the Local Pack AND the AI-citation layer. Combined with #16, this closes the GBP review-recency loop end to end — bump up in effective priority even though tier stays 2. RE-CONFIRMED 2026-09-04: no new counter-signal; the AI-Mode local pack now often shows just 1-2 businesses instead of 3 (Sterling Sky tracking cited across SEL coverage through this window), which increases the relative importance of any recency-tied slot.

items.title: Start a blog (2 posts/month)
files: PR #108 Practitioner Spotlight infra can be extended rather than a from-scratch build
items.body: Short evidence-based articles per condition. Each post: author byline with Physician schema, datePublished, dateModified, 3–5 FAQs. Ahrefs analysis of 17M AI citations (April 2026) found AI-cited content is 25.7% fresher than traditional Google organic results — 76.4% of ChatGPT's top-cited pages were updated within the last 30 days. Freshness compounds. Confirmed 2026-08-07: 70% of AI Overview cited pages churn within 2–3 months (Search Engine Journal July 2026 AI-Mode-after-one-year study); pages updated within the past two months earn 28% more AI citations than older material. osteopath-christchurch.com still owns headaches/cranial/baby/teeth-grinding/stress/arthritis queries on the strength of one short blog post per condition; MK Osteopathy still owns TMJ the same way; headachetendon.nz (a chiropractor) still #1 for 'lower back pain christchurch'. **STRONG NEW EVIDENCE 2026-09-04 — LEVERAGE ELEVATED**: Meridian's /conditions/pregnancy-back-pain/ debuts at #4 on 'pregnancy back pain christchurch' this run — the SECOND condition-page URL to rank (after /conditions/sports-injury-recovery/), 17+ weeks after the page shipped. This is direct evidence the URL-per-condition thesis holds: dedicated, indexable, schema-marked URLs with citation-ready intros (#31) and structured list blocks (#34) CAN rank in this market. AND the sports-injury regression this run (both sports-injury queries lost their ranks in a single week) argues scale matters — ONE ranked URL is fragile, TEN ranked URLs are not. STARTING POINT: PR #108's Practitioner Spotlight infrastructure — the Decap collection config, JSON-LD, homepage surface and image handling can be adapted rather than built from scratch. Consensus in late-Aug commentary: depth > velocity — 2 posts/month is fine if each is genuinely useful. AI Overviews respond to 68% of local searches now (Semrush AI Overviews study) and position-1 organic CTR fell from 1.41% to 0.64% on pages where an AIO appears (Ahrefs, -54% effective drop) — traditional-organic-only strategy is losing yield, so the AI-citation angle matters even more.

items.title: Seed Reddit / community brand mentions (Perplexity-oriented)
items.body: Genuine, non-spammy answers on r/newzealand / r/chch / r/AskNZ threads about osteopathy, ACC claims, back pain. **POSTURE REBALANCED 2026-09-04**: Between Jul 1 and Aug 19, 2026, Perplexity supplied 71% of tracked Reddit citations while ChatGPT supplied 23%; ChatGPT Search citations linking to Reddit fell from ~250/day in early Aug to 16/day the week after Aug 14 — a -94% decline in six days. Reddit's Perplexity share is now ~24%, Gemini 0.1%. This rebalances the pitch: (a) target Perplexity-visibility as the primary win — Perplexity's citation pool is smaller and more curated, so a single well-structured Reddit answer can surface in Perplexity answer cards if it directly answers the query; (b) treat ChatGPT-visibility as a bonus, not a target, given the current decline (though it's recovered from similar drops earlier this year — may return); (c) ClaudeBot overtook GPTBot at 16.28% vs 9.74% (Cloudflare July 2026), and Claude's Reddit-indexing path is a separate open question. **The time-decay clock is running**: Perplexity motion to dismiss the Reddit scraping suit was rejected 31 Jul; Reddit/Google $60M/yr licensing renewal talks stalled; the ChatGPT-Reddit collapse this window is one instance of that decay playing out. If Reddit tightens access to Perplexity too, this lever narrows further. Recommend acting in the next 60 days. 90/10 rule: 90% non-promotional, 2–4 weeks of karma-building before any mention of Meridian.

items.title: Encourage monthly Google reviews nudge + personalised response SLA
items.body: Post-consultation email nudge via Resend (already wired). AI engines prefer reviews under 12 months old. REINFORCED 2026-08-07: Whitespark's 2026 Local Search Ranking Factors report names review recency as the #1 individual local ranking factor. Reviews <30 days carry full algorithmic weight; 30–180 days decays to 10–20%; 73% of consumers only trust reviews from the last month (Epicware / DigitalApplied July 2026). Gemini and AI Overviews now use review sentiment + keywords to pick which local businesses to recommend — freshness now compounds across Local Pack AND AI citation. Healthcare best-practice = at least 1 new review/week. Combined with #13 (auto-fetch reviews at build time), this closes the GBP review-recency loop end to end. **UPDATED 2026-09-04 — response-cadence discipline added**: Whitespark 2026 now tracks owner response within 48 hours as a separate behavioral signal (89% of consumers expect businesses to respond to reviews; 81% expect a reply within a week; next-day expectations climbed to 32% from 18% a year ago). BrightLocal 2026 consumer survey: 50% of consumers are actively put off by generic or templated review responses. Recommendation refined: (a) same-week response as a hard floor, (b) 24-48hr target for freshness weight, (c) response text must be PERSONALISED (name the specific practitioner or treatment the reviewer mentioned; avoid template language). AI-Mode local pack now often shows 1-2 businesses instead of 3 (Sterling Sky tracking) — fewer slots means the response-rate + recency signals matter more relative to a broader 3-slot pack. The nudge template should include a hand-off note on the clinic side to reply promptly AND personally.

items.title: Build an /acc/ landing page — Active Health / osteo.co.nz own ACC queries
items.body: Active Health owns 'osteopath acc christchurch' at #1 with explicit ACC messaging (2026-08-14 baseline; not re-checked this run), chchosteopaths.co.nz was #2, osteo.co.nz #4; House of Acupuncture owns 'acupuncture acc christchurch'. UPDATED 2026-09-04: 'acupuncture acc christchurch' saw major SERP churn this run — burwoodacupuncture.co.nz took #1 (was outside top 5 last check), koruhealing.co.nz new to top 5. The ACC-acupuncture side of this query is currently contestable but not yet in Meridian's favour. We have ACC pricing scattered across the site but no single indexable /acc/ URL. PR #113 rewrote all site-wide ACC copy from 'we lodge claims for you' to 'ACC-registered provider' framing after Google Ads disapproved the clinic under the 'Government documents and official services' policy — the /acc/ page must follow the same discipline. Describe (a) that Meridian is an ACC-registered treatment provider (osteopathy — Nina Hu; acupuncture — Min Jin); (b) the current ACC subsidy amount and what a patient pays out-of-pocket; (c) that no referral is required to book; (d) an explicit non-affiliation line with a link to acc.co.nz (matches PR #113's disclaimer for the manual Ads-review reviewer). Do NOT describe the mechanics of claim filing on the patient's behalf. Passage-level extraction still matters (88% of health queries trigger AI Overview, 83% zero-click per July 2026 SEJ healthcare-AI data) — a tight 40–60 word intro block per item #31's pattern should lead the page.

items.title: Add /conditions/concussion/ page — Triskelion Concussion Care owns 'concussion osteopath christchurch'
items.body: First check 2026-05-22 of 'concussion osteopath christchurch' showed triskelionconcussioncare.co.nz at #1, osteo.co.nz/concussion/ at #2, triskelionosteopathy.co.nz/concussion/ at #3. Reinforced 2026-06-05 and 2026-08-07: same dominant Triskelion + Better Health + osteo.co.nz + Moorhouse + HeadWise + Halswell set. 2026-08-14: SERP CHURN — osteo.co.nz took #1 back from triskelionconcussioncare.co.nz. Concussion queries NOT re-checked this run (2026-09-04) — carried over from Aug 14 baseline; prioritise for next run. Concussion is high-value, ACC-adjacent injury content (post-concussion symptoms — headaches, dizziness, fatigue, brain fog — overlap directly with headache/migraine and neck pain conditions we already treat). **Triskelion is now expanding across body-region queries** — this run showed triskelionconcussioncare.co.nz new #1 on 'arthritis osteopath christchurch' and new top-2 on 'back pain osteopath christchurch'. Their brand is spreading beyond concussion, which makes the case for a defensive Meridian concussion page more urgent, not less. The smallest fix is a /conditions/concussion/ page mirroring the existing pattern (sciatica, neck-pain, back-pain, headaches-migraines, pregnancy-back-pain, sports-injury-recovery): MedicalCondition + FAQPage schema, 40–60 word citation-ready intro (per #31's pattern), structured 5–7 item list blocks (per #34's pattern), acute-vs-chronic / when-to-seek-urgent-care / ACC eligibility (matching PR #113's provider-status framing, not claim-filing mechanics) / how osteopathy fits / book-now sections. Add corresponding entry to conditions.json (including the `lists` array structure introduced in #34) and a tile in the homepage 'Common conditions we treat' grid. Page pattern exists to copy; effort S. **The pregnancy-back-pain #4 ranking this run is direct precedent** — condition-page URLs with the full pattern rank.

items.title: Enable Google Search Console Generative AI performance report + capture baseline
items.body: Google launched a dedicated Generative AI performance report in Search Console on 2026-06-03 that tracks impressions for AI Overviews and AI Mode, broken down by pages, countries, devices and dates at hourly through monthly granularity. UPDATED 2026-08-14 — BASELINE CORRECTION: the report is STILL impressions-only — no CTR, no clicks, no query data (per Aug 2026 write-ups from Pragma-Code, Weblumino, TJ Robertson, SmartTeam). The July 'CTR added' note was either premature or was rolled back. The report is still worth enabling (AI-surface impressions remain the only first-party AI-visibility signal we can get), but the end-to-end 'AI-surface → click → booking' attribution story pairs with the STANDARD Performance report's existing CTR column, not the Gen AI panel — until Google actually ships CTR there. RE-CONFIRMED 2026-09-04: no new news on Gen-AI-panel CTR through this window; the panel remains impressions-only. The opt-out toggle went live 2026-06-17 (~11 weeks ago); since properties are opt-in by default, the report should still be capturing unless explicitly disabled. Action items: (1) verify meridianosteopathy.co.nz is a verified property in the clinic's GSC account, (2) confirm the AI Overviews / AI Mode toggle is still ON, (3) screenshot the report's default 3-month window as a 'pre-blog' baseline (~3 months of data now available) before item #14 ships, (4) build the AI-surface-attribution story on Performance-report CTR paired with the GA4 booking_completed event added in PR #116, NOT on a Gen-AI-panel CTR column that does not yet exist. Use the SEJ CTR-loss diagnostic framing ('stable rankings + stable impressions + falling CTR = AI Overview click loss') against the standard Performance report as a diagnostic overlay against the Gen AI impression trend for the same URL set. No code changes needed.

items.title: Add a postpartum recovery section or dedicated /conditions/postpartum-recovery/ page — thin SERP opportunity
items.body: First-run check 2026-08-14 of 'postpartum osteopath christchurch' (US-variant of postnatal) returned only 6 total Google results — betterhealthosteopathy.nz, osteo.co.nz, osteopath-christchurch.com and 3 aggregators. Second check 2026-09-04 CONFIRMS the thin-SERP pattern holds: still ~5-6 results with bambinoosteo.co.nz (Auckland) + porthillsosteo.co.nz new to visible results. A hollow SERP that a targeted page could rank on with minimal effort — the same SERP-churn pattern that let /conditions/sports-injury-recovery/ and /conditions/pregnancy-back-pain/ break through. **NEW ARGUMENT 2026-09-04**: the pregnancy-back-pain #4 ranking this run is direct precedent that the condition-page pattern works on pregnancy / postnatal intent. A /conditions/postpartum-recovery/ page shares the same audience and would benefit from adjacent-page internal-link authority. Two implementation options: (a) EXTEND — add a 'Postpartum recovery' H2 section to the existing /conditions/pregnancy-back-pain/ page with US-spelling variants in body copy (postpartum, postnatal, post-birth) and appropriate MedicalCondition JSON-LD updates, keeping single-page authority (RISK: the pregnancy-back-pain page just started ranking — do not dilute its focus); or (b) NEW PAGE — /conditions/postpartum-recovery/ following the standard condition-page pattern (MedicalCondition + FAQPage schema, 40–60 word citation-ready intro per #31, structured list blocks per #34), separate URL to catch the exact-slug search intent. Option (b) is now MORE strongly indicated given the pregnancy-back-pain ranking win — do not risk that URL's focus, ship a fresh URL instead. Add a tile to the homepage 'Common conditions we treat' grid. Effort S.
